comment: S29b T6. The web_search capability row (S29b T1): with web_search registered, 'No, I can't search the web.' / 'I don't have web search.' are false and the capability guard corrects them, filing its span. WHAT IS MEASURED: guard_absent(capability_claim) — she did not deny a tool she holds. A plain 'Yes' is green; she need not search to answer the question. WHAT IT CANNOT MEASURE: that a search she then runs answers — searches-for-latest-pixel is that. Added with the S29b corpus bump (21 -> 22).
